notes: Governmental funds on the modified cash basis (recorded as cash); business-type (Water, Sewer, Garbage) on the accrual basis. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p5); Bond proceeds 340,000 is inside the printed Total revenues and is recorded as debt_proceeds (reported_totals includes debt_proceeds). Beginning/ending cash = fund balances (no liabilities; p4 total assets 3,458,447). ending_investments = certificates of deposit 1,217,490 (p4), informational. Taxes are printed by type; no split needed. Business-type from the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position total column (p7); receipts total is operating + nonoperating revenues (computed), disbursements total 1,106,566 printed on the Statement of Activities (p2). 'Environment and leisure' recorded as culture/recreation (park, pool, library, museum per p15). Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position Total column (p1). Detail: General Fund by department from the departmental combining statement (p14-15), which supersedes the General Fund budgetary comparison schedule (p10, same fund; not recorded); Street and LB840 budget schedules (p11-12); nonmajor combining statement per fund (p13). The Debt Service Fund and the enterprise funds have no supplementary schedule, so no detail lines for them. The report counts the Cemetery department in Public works on p5; in detail it is health/welfare. Zero-amount lines omitted. Read pages 1-15 of 15.
